name: Grass-leaved Goldenrod
desc: Grass-leaved Goldenrod (Euthamia graminifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euthamia graminifolia, the grass-leaved goldenrod or flat-top goldenrod, is a North American species of plants in the family Asteraceae.
